observation.command:
cd /workspace && cat > .env <<EOF
# ── Environment ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ENVIRONMENT=production
LOG_LEVEL=info
LOG_LEVEL_HTTP=info
SEND_SERVER_ERROR_MESSAGE=false

# ── Server / CORS ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
CORE_BACKEND_DOMAIN=http://localhost:4000
FRONTEND_DOMAIN=http://localhost:3000
NEXT_PUBLIC_CORE_BACKEND_DOMAIN=http://localhost:4000
SCHOOL_SLUG=eckener-schule
TRUST_PROXY=1
AUTH_RATE_LIMIT_MAX=300

# ── Database ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
DB_USER=daz
DB_PASS=$(cat /tmp/sec_dbpass)
DB_NAME=daz
DB_SSL=false
DB_POOL_SIZE=10
DB_DEBUG_SLOW_DB_ACCESS=0
DB_MAX_DEADLOCKS=100

# ── ML-Service ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ML_DEVICE=auto
ML_SERVICE_TIMEOUT_MS=120000

# ── Media storage & ingest ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
MEDIA_PUBLIC_PATH=/media
MEDIA_URL_SIGNING_KEY=$(cat /tmp/sec_media)
FRAME_EXTRACTION_FPS=3
FRAME_EXTRACTION_CANDIDATES_PER_FRAME=3

# ── Secrets ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
SUPER_ADMIN_API_KEY=$(cat /tmp/sec_super_admin)
SECRETS_ENCRYPTION_KEY=$(cat /tmp/sec_encryption)

# ── SMTP ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
SMTP_ENABLED=true
SMTP_HOST=mailcatcher
SMTP_PORT=1025
SMTP_USERNAME=
SMTP_PASSWORD=
SMTP_FROM_EMAIL=noreply@daz-pilot.local
SMTP_FROM_NAME=DaZ-Pilot

# ── Mobile app links ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
UPLOAD_KEY_FINGERPRINT=
PLAY_APP_SIGNING_FINGERPRINT=
APPLE_APP_TEAM_ID=

# ── Backups ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
BACKUP_SCHEDULE=0 3 * * *
BACKUP_RETENTION_DAYS=30
AGE_RECIPIENT=$(cat /tmp/sec_age_pub)
BACKUP_ALLOW_PLAINTEXT=false
EOF
chmod 600 .env && grep -c . .env && grep -E "^(ENVIRONMENT|SCHOOL_SLUG|TRUST_PROXY|SMTP_HOST|AGE_RECIPIENT|DB_PASS)" .env
